user.title: Set up Google Photos Backup
user.description: Choose which backend should be used to back up photos/videos. See the README for details - in short: 'takeout' is currently the only way to fully back up an existing library.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Google Photos Backup
reauth_confirm.description: Google rejected the stored access grant for this instance (revoked, expired, or scope changed) - sign in again to keep backups running.

library_api_options.title: Target directory & interval
library_api_options.description: Note: this backend can only see media uploaded by this integration itself, plus whatever you manually select via a Picker session (start_picker_session service). It does NOT automatically read your whole existing library.

rclone.title: Configure rclone backend
rclone.description: Note: since March 2025, rclone's googlephotos backend can also only download files it uploaded itself. For an existing library the Takeout backend is usually the better choice.

takeout_drive_choice.title: Google Drive sync?
takeout_drive_choice.description: Optionally poll a Google Drive location directly for new Takeout export archives (as delivered by Takeout's own 'Scheduled exports' feature), download them in automatically, and optionally delete them from Drive again once imported - instead of relying on a separate external sync step into the watch directory. Needs its own Google sign-in granting read access to your whole Drive plus permission to manage (trash/delete) file metadata - the delete itself stays off by default, see the next step. Requires the Drive API enabled on the same Google Cloud project used for library_api - see README.

takeout.title: Configure Takeout backend
takeout.description: Drop Google Takeout export archives (.zip/.tgz) into the watch directory - the integration extracts them, files media by capture date from the JSON sidecar, and deduplicates via file hashes.

data.takeout_download_links: Takeout email download links (one per line, optional)

takeout_drive_options.title: Configure Takeout backend (with Drive sync)
takeout_drive_options.description: Same as the plain Takeout backend, plus an optional Drive folder ID to search in (leave empty to search all of My Drive for 'takeout-*' archives) and whether to clean up archives in Drive once imported.

data.takeout_download_links: Takeout email download links (one per line, optional)
data.takeout_drive_folder_id: Drive folder ID to search (empty = all of My Drive)
data.takeout_drive_delete_after_sync: Delete archive from Drive after successful import
data.takeout_drive_delete_permanently: Delete permanently instead of moving to trash (frees quota immediately, NOT recoverable)

abort.reauth_entry_missing: The instance was removed while re-authenticating - nothing to update.
abort.missing_configuration: The integration is not configured correctly (Application Credentials missing). See README.

data.takeout_drive_delete_after_sync: Delete archive from Drive after successful import
data.takeout_drive_delete_permanently: Delete permanently instead of moving to trash (frees quota immediately, NOT recoverable)
